sources.title: Gemma 3 Technical Report - arXiv.org
sources.snippet: Abstract We introduce Gemma 3, a multimodal addition to the Gemma family of lightweight open models, ranging in scale from 1 to 27 billion parameters. This version introduces vision understanding abilities, a wider coverage of languages and longer context - at least 128K tokens.
